goal: Evaluate whether sildenafil should advance for severe early-onset fetal growth restriction, distinguishing biological plausibility from demonstrated clinical benefit and serious neonatal safety concerns.

replay.description: Begin with a plausible PDE5/NO-cGMP mechanism. Reveal UK and Dutch STRIDER outcomes without allowing later findings to influence earlier recommendations. Historical experiments are from separate trials, not a single sequential program.

nodes.name: PDE5 / NO-cGMP Rationale
nodes.question: Could PDE5 inhibition plausibly improve uteroplacental vascular function?

nodes.name: Uteroplacental Perfusion Response
nodes.question: Does sildenafil improve disease-relevant placental perfusion at adequate exposure?

nodes.name: Fetal Growth Response
nodes.question: Does any physiological improvement translate into better fetal growth?

nodes.name: Pregnancy Prolongation
nodes.question: Does treatment meaningfully prolong pregnancy in severe early-onset FGR?

nodes.name: Meaningful Perinatal Benefit
nodes.question: Does sildenafil improve important neonatal or pregnancy outcomes?

gaps: Clinical benefit not established at historical starting point.

nodes.name: Neonatal Safety / Pulmonary Hypertension
nodes.question: Is the treatment acceptably safe for the fetus and newborn, including pulmonary hypertension risk?

nodes.name: Repurposing Viability
nodes.question: Should sildenafil advance for severe early-onset FGR given both efficacy and safety?

experiments.name: Placental Vascular / Perfusion Assessment
experiments.interpretation_notes: Illustrative experimental option, not a claimed STRIDER historical result; check dose, assay quality, and model.

experiments.name: Serial Ultrasound Fetal Growth Assessment
experiments.interpretation_notes: Illustrative standalone test, not a separately documented STRIDER outcome in this dataset.

experiments.name: UK STRIDER: Time from Randomization to Delivery
experiments.interpretation_notes: UK trial: median 17 days sildenafil vs 18 days placebo; no significant improvement. Negative = no demonstrated efficacy, not proof of no possible effect.

experiments.name: UK STRIDER: Birthweight and Perinatal Outcomes
experiments.interpretation_notes: UK trial did not demonstrate meaningful improvements in birthweight or major perinatal outcomes; endpoints from same trial are correlated, not independent experiments.

experiments.name: Dutch STRIDER: Perinatal Mortality / Major Morbidity
experiments.interpretation_notes: Dutch trial: 60.2% sildenafil vs 54.2% placebo for primary composite; no demonstrated benefit. A negative result alone requires interpretation of power, confidence intervals, and safety.

experiments.name: Dutch STRIDER: Neonatal Pulmonary Hypertension Safety
experiments.interpretation_notes: Unfavorable safety outcome: neonatal pulmonary hypertension 18.8% sildenafil vs 5.1% placebo; trial stopped early. Safety review is mandatory; not an autonomous clinical decision.

experiments.name: UK STRIDER: Two-Year Child Follow-up
experiments.interpretation_notes: Later follow-up did not demonstrate improved neurodevelopment; reveal only after the original trials in chronology-aware replay.

historical_ground_truth.planner_visibility: Historical results hidden until selected/revealed; later follow-up cannot be revealed in an earlier replay period.

dependency_semantics.all: All listed required nodes must remain viable.
dependency_semantics.any: At least one alternative remains viable.

planner_rules.kill_guardrail: Mechanism failure or an uninterpretable assay alone cannot kill the candidate. Strong, trustworthy clinical evidence or unacceptable safety may justify candidate NO-GO.
planner_rules.qc_guardrail: QUESTIONABLE or FAIL QC cannot automatically cause candidate kill; urgent safety signals must trigger human review even before definitive causal confirmation.
planner_rules.safety_override: Credible serious neonatal harm triggers safety review / pause and may override promising mechanism results; human review required.
planner_rules.endpoint_correlation: UK efficacy outcomes are correlated endpoints of one trial; do not double count them as independent replication.
planner_rules.result_semantics: Negative means unfavorable for candidate: lack of efficacy or excess harm; it does not mean a negative laboratory measurement.

assumptions: Cost/time values are normalized 1-5 hackathon estimates, not measured trial budgets or durations.
Initial confidence values are illustrative and not calibrated probabilities.
Placental perfusion and standalone fetal growth tests are illustrative options, not asserted to have known historical results in this file.
Historical trial outcomes should be revealed with appropriate time ordering; UK and Dutch STRIDER were separate studies.
The Dutch pulmonary hypertension finding is a safety signal, not proof of the causal mechanism.
Final NO-GO is for sildenafil for severe early-onset FGR, not all established sildenafil indications.
